2a1(ba): @#/tshim pa yi//lhan cog skyes pa'i ngo bor gsal//ma lus bde tshon rang bzhin du//snang zhen thog le'i ngo bor ldog/thun mongs thun mongs ma yin pa'i//rtag

2a4(ba): de nas gsang bdag sprul pa'i sku//'dod lnga chags dang thabs sbyor bas//thabs kyis gsang ba'i don ston pa//ma lus dgongs pa'i don thob pas//thog mtha' med pa'i thabs la

2b2(ba): chen pos//'khor ba gnyis med don sbyor ba//'di ni thabs che na rol po'i rgyud//zhus dang de la dgongs pa'i phyir//'di ni gsang chen thal ba'i rgyud//'di tshe gsang bdag mnyam 'dus pas//'khor gyi
2b3(ba): rigs lnga rgyal po yis//'khor lo'i bdag po gtso bo la//'dod dang mnyes dang tshogs kyis mchog/dgyes pa chen po rol pa mchod//gsang ba'i don gzigs zab mo'i dbyangs//'dod chags rol pa'i
2b4(ba): stabs kyis zhugs//e ma ho gar mkhan 'khor la bde//rtag tu bde bas bde ba'i mchog/bde stong rtog pa gnyis min zhing //gsang ba gsang chen gsang ba'i mchog/'dus pa'i 'khor lo sbyong mdzad
2b5(ba): ba/mtha' dang dbus sogs dus med pa//lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor gnas//thabs chen rgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud//gsang chen thabs kyi rol pa 'di//thun mongs thun mongs ma yin pa'i//gle gzhi mchog
2b6(ba): ni ji ltar lags//rol pas gsang ba las 'byung ba'i//sems kyi khyad par ji lta bu//gsang ba'i thabs ma chog las 'byung ba'i//lha dang rtog pa'i khyad par gyi//rgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sku gsung thugs//
2b7(ba): nga bzhin thabs las rang sdang ba'i/ dkyil 'khor mchog ni ji ltar lags//phyi nang gzugs rnyan byang chub sems//rigs pa thig le mngon snang ba//khyad par rim pas ji ltar lags//gsang ba
3a1(ba): gas 'tshon mthar thug pa'o//rim pa gang lags khyad kyis gsungs//'dul ba'i skye bo snod ldan la//gsang ba'i dam tshig ji ltar sbyin//thabs chen rol pa'i dbang mchog gang //rig

3a3(ba): lta lta bu//'dod pa con la rol sbyang bas//'gro ba chags can ji ltar dgrol//zhe sdang can gyi gang zag la//rig pa'i bag chag ji ltar sdud//las kyis khyad par ji ltar lags//rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor
3a4(ba): bas//tshad dang grol ba'i tshad ni gang //thabs dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor pas//gsang ba spyad pas ji ltar 'gyur//thabs mkhas rol pa'i rnal 'byor pas//spyad pas lhun gyis ji ltar grub//'das
3a5(ba): dang ma 'ongs rnal 'byor pas//lhun gyis ji ltar 'grub par 'gyur//dbang po yul dus ji ltar lags//yid ches brtan pa gang lags pa//thabs ltan theg pa'i che ba gang //'dul ba'i gang
3a6(ba): zag rgyal sras la//thabs kyi theg pa gang ltar sbyim/'di dag thabs chen gsang ba'i don//ma lus sdus par zhus pa ni//dus gsum the tsom sel ba ste//rlud kyi phyi ma zab mo mchog/'dod chag/
3b1(ba): brtul shugs mchog chen po//'dus pa kun gyi rje su gsungs//de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'chang lha mo'i tshogs dang gnyis med cing //rol pa'i gar dgu rtse dang bcas//ma lus bde bas tshim mdzad nas//'khor lo rol pa'i tshogs dang bcas/
3b2(ba): thabs kyi rol pa ba'i chen gyis//lus kyi dkyil 'khor 'bebs mdzad cing //bzhin 'gyur dag chad ro dag med//rnal 'byor po mo rdul snyed bcas//rje gcig bde ba 'bar bar byed//bde chen thig le'i tshul nyid kyis//rdo rje'i tshigatu
3b3(ba): 'di gsungs pa//'di zhes nyes pas mtshon pa ni//e sogs rnam bzhi dbyibs can gnas//skad ces gsal byed las ming can//bam dbyibs thig ler bcas ston pas//tha ma ma nu sdom byed pa'i yid//las can rnams
3b4(ba): de dag la//thabs chen tshigs bral nyams ldan pas//gsal bar go bas bshad par 'dod//ba sgra don dam nges pa'i rgyud//ya na theg chen 'di yin no//dus ni bsam gyis mi khyab dus//nA ma de ni ming zhes bya'o//gzhan yang
3b5(ba): khyad par bshad bya ba//thabs dang shes rab mnyem pa yi//sna tshogs bde ba'i thig le yis//de bzhin nyid du gshegs pa yang //sna tshogs zhen las grol bar bshad//bye brag brgya bcu bcu gsum la//ma lus bde chen ngo bo
3b6(ba): yid na bcud 'dus thig le'i chen po nyid//snang dang stong pa la sogs pa//brjod bya ma lus rdzogs par snang //rtog tshogs sangs rgyas bzhi bcu lnga//snang bas phyi phyir gnyis su med//shes rab pa ga gsang ba'i gnas//de dkyil pad+ma
3b7(ba): rims gsum mo//gnyis gsum brgyad kyi khyad par can//mtha' la gnas dang yon+ta gyis//mngon par mtho bas 'og min te//las dang bcud kyi mtha' bral ba//ye shes gzhi la dpag mi rig/gos pa 'byung ldan rin po che/
4a1(ba): @#ye shes lnga'i 'khor lo bskor//sangs rgyas ngo bo snod bcud kyis/ka spyi bo shin tu 'khyil bar gnas//nyung kar sor gyi dpags pa ni//sa ya bcu gsum bde bas brgyan//sna tshogs ro dang ldan pa yi//'dod yon khyang /
4a2(ba): bar can gyis mdzes//bde ba chen po kur khyab pa'i//gang yang bde byed phyi nang sprul//bang pa chen po ro nyid la//'bras bus chos gcig rdzogs par ldan//byang chub mchog tu nyi zla 'char//de nyid bzhugs gnas yin par bshad //bcus
4a3(ba): lnga ye shes kho na'i phyir//dngas smig med par kun du gsal//sgra dbyangs gsung gi granas gzhi yis//dbye bas gsum gsum ngo bo gnyis dang //bzhi bcu gnyis su gyur pa ni//sa ya bcu gsum la sogs par//skye 'gag med pa'i ngo/
4a4(ba): bor yang //rten can ji bzhin rten de ni//nyi zla thabs dang shes rab kyis//ro gnyis mnyam par dus gsum bzhugs//dngas ma'i thig le chen po yi//bde ba'i dngos por ye shes snang //thabs dang shes rab mi phyed pa'i//thig le gas
4a5(ba): ba'i ro ldan pa'i//mtshan nyid kun bcom bde chen po//rang gi ngo bo ma grub pa//rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i phyir//bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs shes bya//gzugs sogs lhag pa'i thig le ni//las dang yon tan sngon bstan phyir//rig
4a6(ba): pa'i rgyal po nyid du brjod//bcud lnga 'dus pa'i thig le ni//rgyud du gnas kyi kha dog ldan//ro dang las kyang de bzhin te//rang gi mtshan nyid kun du snang //gang phyir 'byung sogs rang bzhin nyid//chen po'i bdag nyid lngar snang ba//mkha' sogs sgying /
4a7(ba): la gang gnas pa//nyams dang sbyor ba'i khyad par gyis//zab mo dbang gi stobs las snang //khyad par rim bzhin shes par bya//mkha' sogs nang gi 'byung las snang //ye shes 'byung lnga las dag gis//bskyed phyir dbying su brjod pa te//btsun mo'i/
4b1(ba): dngos po 'di 'dod do//'byung lnga sbyor ba'i thabs mkhas pa//thig le snod kyi khyad par gyi//til gang ltar bu mkha' gang ba//dkyil 'khor tshogs chen brjod mi lang //gang phyir thig le'i byin brlabs pa//rig pa'i tshul bzhin bsam mi/

4b4(ba): cha bcud bcas pa ltar//zag med thabs kyi rang bzhin gyis//bde ba bskyed phyir btsun mo'o//dus ni rlung gis go phye ste/khyams pa la sogs ye shes bzhi//de bde rim pas skye ba yang //ting 'dzin dbang du nges par gsungs//thabs dang shes rab
4b5(ba): mi phyed pa//gsang bas mnyam sbyor thabs kyis phyir//gsang yum dbang po rnam shes reg/lus kyi chos bzhi 'dus spyad pas/ma lus 'joms phyir khro bo ste//mtshan nyid las kyis phye ba yin//gsang gsum thabs kyi spyod pa nyid//rtag sogs ma cha nam

11b3(ba2): gshegs 'khor lo sku'i dbyig/zhing khams mtha' yas rgyal ba'i cho gas/g.yon tan rin chen che gnas sbyor//de dag gdod nas kun rdzogs mdzad//gsung gi pad+ma rnam par dag//chos kyi rgyud kyi ting 'dzin gyi/

11b7(ba2): gsal dro smin pa pad+mo'i chos//bskyod pa'i 'phrin las kun rdzogs//don 'thun rtags kyi phyag nyid //btsun mo dam pa'i cha lugs kyis//de dag dkyil 'khor bstan par mdzad//dam pa kun dang sna tshogs pa'i / tshul yang dag

12a4(ba2): dag par mdzad//thabs bcas ma 'dres byams pa'i stobs//sgrib med mun pa'i tshogs sel zhing ka/kun nas spyod pa bzang po nyid//shes rab chen po'i chos mthar phyin gsung gi dbang po rnam dag pas//rigs kyi ye shes gas

13b1(ba2): ma bcos pa//de dag rgyang dang 'bras bu'i//tshul bzhin bstan pas rnam par spyod//'gro ba 'dul ba'i ting 'dzin gyis//dkyil 'khor phyag rgya sngags rdzogs pa'i khro bo dkyil 'khor mngon snang zhing //rang gi 'phrin las brtsan pa'i bdag

13b3(ba2): bya ba rdzogs par 'gyur//gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor rgya chen pos//sa gzhi mnyam la gnas rdzogs pa//phyogs mtshams kun tu shis pa'i las//mngon par bsngags pa ji lta bu//yang dag dkyil 'khor thig gdab cing //yang dag
